title: Poria cocos polysaccharides alleviate colitis via the tryptophan metabolism-AhR-redox axis.
authors: Cheng, Haishan; Peng, Fang; Gong, Yinuo; Zhu, Jun; Liao, Hongtao; Li, Rong; Qin, Meilin; Yan, Zhuoya; Wang, Shenghao; Su, Xingyue; Wang, Hanfei; Zhang, Fuxian; Wu, Yi; Guo, Liwei; Che, Yanyun
one_liner_zh: 研究茯苓多糖通过色氨酸代谢-AhR-氧化还原轴缓解结肠炎，仅含分子对接验证小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Poria cocos (Fuling), a classic edible and medicinal fungus with a 2000-year clinical application history in traditional Chinese medicine, is well-documented for its core efficacies of "invigorating the spleen and relieving diarrhea", which is highly consistent with the core clinical manifestations of infectious colitis including persistent diarrhea, intestinal barrier impairment and mucosal inflammation. Poria cocos polysaccharides (PCP) are recognized as the primary bioactive component of Poria cocos, with proven anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory activities. However, whether PCP exerts its anti-colitis effect via regulating the tryptophan (Trp) metabolism-aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) signaling axis remains largely uncharacterized. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic effect of PCP on Salmonella-induced infectious colitis in mice, and systematically elucidate its underlying molecular mechanism focusing on the Trp metabolism-AhR-redox signaling axis. METHODS: A Salmonella typhimurium-induced infectious colitis mouse model was established to evaluate the protective effect of PCP (100, 200, 400 mg/kg) via oral administration. Targeted metabolomics was performed to profile the changes of intestinal Trp metabolites in colitis mice. Histopathological examination, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, western blot, and real-time quantitative PCR were conducted to assess intestinal barrier integrity, intestinal redox status, and the activation of relevant signaling pathways. Molecular docking simulation was used to verify the direct interaction between the key differential metabolite and its target proteins. RESULTS: PCP administration significantly alleviated the clinical symptoms of infectious colitis, restored colon length and organ indices (P < 0.05), and ameliorated colonic pathological damage in a dose-dependent manner. PCP markedly reinforced intestinal epithelial barrier integrity via upregulating the protein expression of tight junction proteins including ZO-1, Occludin and Claudin (P < 0.01). Targeted metabolomics analysis revealed that PCP intervention effectively remodeled the disordered intestinal Trp metabolic profile, especially significantly enriched the endogenous AhR ligand indole-3-lactic acid (I3LA) by 5.5-fold compared with the model group (P < 0.05). Mechanistically, PCP promoted the nuclear translocation of AhR, normalized the aberrant NRF2/HO-1 signaling pathway to restore intestinal redox homeostasis, and subsequently suppressed the hyperactivation of JAK/STAT3 and NF-kappaB inflammatory cascades, with the mRNA levels of core pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-6 and TNF-alpha reduced by more than 70% (P < 0.01). CONCLUSION: Collectively, these findings demonstrate that PCP ameliorates Salmonella-induced infectious colitis via remodeling the intestinal Trp metabolic microenvironment to enrich I3LA, which acts as a molecular switch to activate the AhR-redox axis and further suppress mucosal inflammatory responses. This study provides modern scientific evidence for the traditional "invigorating the spleen and relieving diarrhea" clinical application of Poria cocos, and supports the potential of PCP as a safe and effective prebiotic agent for the prevention and treatment of intestinal inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：茯苓（Fuling）作为一种经典药食两用真菌，在传统中医中拥有2000年的临床应用历史，其“健脾止泻”的核心功效已被充分记载，这与感染性结肠炎的核心临床表现（包括持续性腹泻、肠道屏障损伤和黏膜炎症）高度一致。茯苓多糖（PCP）被认为是茯苓的主要生物活性成分，已证实具有抗炎和免疫调节活性。然而，PCP是否通过调节色氨酸（Trp）代谢-芳香烃受体（AhR）信号轴发挥其抗结肠炎作用仍 largely 未被表征。目的：本研究旨在探讨PCP对沙门氏菌诱导的小鼠感染性结肠炎的治疗效果，并系统阐明其潜在分子机制，重点关注Trp代谢-AhR-氧化还原信号轴。方法：建立鼠伤寒沙门氏菌诱导的感染性结肠炎小鼠模型，评估口服PCP（100、200、400 mg/kg）的保护作用。采用靶向代谢组学分析结肠炎小鼠肠道Trp代谢物的变化。通过组织病理学检查、免疫组织化学、免疫荧光、蛋白质印迹和实时定量PCR评估肠道屏障完整性、肠道氧化还原状态及相关信号通路的激活。分子对接模拟用于验证关键差异代谢物与其靶蛋白之间的直接相互作用。结果：PCP给药显著缓解了感染性结肠炎的临床症状，恢复结肠长度和器官指数（P < 0.05），并以剂量依赖性方式改善结肠病理损伤。PCP通过上调紧密连接蛋白（包括ZO-1、Occludin和Claudin）的蛋白表达，显著增强肠道上皮屏障完整性（P < 0.01）。靶向代谢组学分析显示，PCP干预有效重塑了紊乱的肠道Trp代谢谱，尤其是与模型组相比，内源性AhR配体吲哚-3-乳酸（I3LA）显著富集了5.5倍（P < 0.05）。机制上，PCP促进AhR核转位，使异常的NRF2/HO-1信号通路正常化以恢复肠道氧化还原稳态，并随后抑制JAK/STAT3和NF-kappaB炎症级联反应的过度激活，核心促炎细胞因子IL-6和TNF-alpha的mRNA水平降低超过70%（P < 0.01）。结论：综合来看，这些发现表明PCP通过重塑肠道Trp代谢微环境以富集I3LA来改善沙门氏菌诱导的感染性结肠炎，I3LA作为分子开关激活AhR-氧化还原轴并进一步抑制黏膜炎症反应。本研究为茯苓“健脾止泻”的传统临床应用提供了现代科学证据，并支持PCP作为安全有效的益生元制剂在预防和治疗肠道炎症性疾病中的潜力。
